ModMetaData.name: CCTO for VPE（CCTO VPE対応）
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
In development: VPE cold-tolerance compatibility using the existing CCTO XML API. Fourteen ordinary VPE 1.6 plants have individual minimum-growth and cold-death or winter-dormancy settings. Six custom-class plants are not yet supported. Not independently tested in a running game: compatibility fixes will be based on user bug reports. Report issues at https://github.com/sucRo-RimWorld/CCTO-for-VPE/issues .
開発中。VPEの通常植物14種にCCTOの最低生育温度・枯死温度・低温休眠を設定するXMLを実装した。独自植物クラス6種は対象外。実ゲーム未検証。利用者からのバグ報告に基づき修正する。報告先：https://github.com/sucRo-RimWorld/CCTO-for-VPE/issues 。
